Queue item CLK-002: Wall-clock stamps must not create standalone user messages (operator directive)
Payload/instructions:
{
  "spec_source": "operator live feedback 2026-09-24 16:10: \"adding these empty user messages just for the timestamp is a little overdone. the idea was that the timestamp should be there, but dont put in a user message block just for timestamps sake\"",
  "observed": "Between-turn user messages containing only \"[pragma wall-clock ...]\" appear in the conversation (e.g. the 12:02:51 stamp visible in the operator TUI as a bare user turn) - the CLK-001 companion message after each tool-results batch.",
  "constraint": "The model must still see the current wall clock each turn. CLK-001 documented why the stamp cannot ride INSIDE the tool-results message (a text part serializes before its tool results, breaking pairing) - so do NOT move it into the results message. Preferred mechanism: a per-request dynamic system block (like systemWithMCPStatus/systemWithHarnessManifest) carrying the current wall-clock, rebuilt each request; remove the companion user message entirely. Turn-budget/self-continue notices keep their existing first-line stamp inside real text appends.",
  "deliverables": "RED test: tool-results batch followed by NO wall-clock user message AND next request system contains the stamp; GREEN with the system-block mechanism; adjacent: session files must not contain wall-clock-only user messages for NEW turns; full query suite; case record CLK-002 referencing this directive as spec source."
}

  then gofmt.
